description: Get one USPTO ex parte Appeal decision by its appeal number (e.g. "2024-001234") — the Board's decision on an applicant's appeal of an examiner rejection. Returns the decision type, issue date, outcome (affirmed / reversed / affirmed-in-part), issues and rules at play, and the decision document title + download link. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

appeal_number.description: Ex parte appeal number, e.g. "2024-001234" (with or without an "Appeal" prefix).

include_raw.description: Optional, default false. When true, also return raw_sample: the UNMODIFIED raw record exactly as the upstream API returned it (no field renaming), to verify or correct this tool's field mapping.

name: ptab_appeal
title: Ptab Appeal
